description: Bounded source mutations for model extended. Outcomes are reported by the native mutation runner.

mutants.description: Treat a two-component mesh as already connected, preventing its split into two independently assigned volumes.
Drop the selected volume transformation while merging, moving the merged component away from its source placement.
Return before converting multiple valid objects into volumes, preserving the wrong object count and topology.
Skip baking a non-right-angle instance rotation, leaving the unsupported transform in the instance.
Apply zero-based relocation keys directly to one-based object and volume extruder settings.
Invert the negative-Z gate so a model already on the bed is translated and a sinking model is left in place.
Use a product instead of the target-to-source scale ratio, violating the requested fit dimensions.
Aggregate untransformed object geometry into the model mesh, losing instance placement.
